wizard_lead: Your account is ready. Every step below is optional, and you can change any of it later in Settings.
wizard_load_failed: This step couldn't load. Reload the page to try again; your progress is kept.
wizard_net_lead: Other DHT nodes can only find you if your DHT port is reachable from the internet. Lodestar watches for unsolicited queries to find out.
wizard_net_error: Couldn't read the network check. Lodestar isn't responding.
wizard_net_reason_dht_off: The DHT is turned off, so there is nothing to check.
wizard_net_reason_bootstrapping: Lodestar is still joining the DHT.
wizard_net_reason_measuring: Waiting for other nodes to contact you.
wizard_net_reason_ok: Nodes you hadn't contacted are reaching your DHT port.
wizard_net_reason_few: Only a few networks have reached you so far. More evidence is needed.
wizard_net_reason_none: No unsolicited queries have arrived in the window.
wizard_net_limited: You can retest once every 30 seconds. Try again shortly.
wizard_net_limited_in: You can retest once every 30 seconds. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
wizard_net_retest_error: Couldn't start the retest. Lodestar isn't responding.
wizard_net_stopped: Still no answer after a long wait. Press Retest to measure again.
wizard_net_help_forward: On your router, forward the DHT port (UDP) to this machine. The port is on the Network settings screen.
wizard_net_help_vpn: Behind a VPN? Use one that supports port forwarding, or accept that fewer nodes will reach you.
wizard_net_help_still: Lodestar works either way. Without a reachable port it simply discovers torrents more slowly.
wizard_how_dht_text: Lodestar joins the BitTorrent DHT and notes which torrents other people are sharing.
wizard_how_metadata_text: For each new torrent it asks a peer for the name and file list. Many torrents are dead and never answer.
wizard_how_index_text: What it learns goes into a local search index on this machine.
wizard_how_search_text: You search your own index. Nothing about your searches leaves this machine.
wizard_how_cold: The index grows over days and weeks, not hours. Expect little in Search at first; it fills as the crawler runs.
wizard_intensity_lead: How hard should Lodestar crawl? Lower is gentler on your network and your router; higher finds torrents faster.
wizard_storage_lead: How Lodestar stores what it finds. The defaults suit most machines.
wizard_updates_lead: Lodestar can look for new versions.
wizard_updates_off_help: Never checks. You update by hand.
wizard_updates_notify_help: Looks for new versions and tells you. You decide when to install.
wizard_updates_auto_help: Looks for new versions and installs them.
wizard_updates_image_help: Your container or Unraid handles updates; Lodestar only tells you.
wizard_updates_github: Checking for updates contacts GitHub. Off is the default, and nothing else is chosen for you.
wizard_updates_locked: This is set by the environment variable {env}. Change it there.
wizard_updates_locked_plain: This is set outside the app and can't be changed here.
wizard_done_skipped: Skipped. Set these in Settings whenever you like:
